about.title: Designer, motion artist,
about.lede: I'm Tushar Karmakar, a Sydney-based senior creative designer turning briefs into campaigns, motion and AI-powered visuals that people actually stop for.
about.bio:
For more than five years I've designed for technology, telecom and SaaS brands, from Samsung's retail and launch campaigns to Akash DTH's nationwide marketing and identities for NGOs and start-ups.

Today I work as a freelance editor and motion designer with M&C Saatchi World Services, blending classic design craft with AI tools like Midjourney, Runway and Veo to move from idea to finished film faster, without losing the human touch.

I studied Computer Science at BRAC University, so I'm as comfortable talking to developers and product teams as I am to art directors.
